text: VIX at 25.64 with CPI accelerating to 3.7% and the Fed signaling one more rate hike ahead — this combination of elevated volatility, sticky inflation, and tightening policy means conditions favor caution over aggressive new positions right now.
Sell RGTI immediately — down 66% from its high, revenue is shrinking by 34%, the company is unprofitable, and massive short interest signals the market sees more downside ahead.
Sell QBTS now — down 67% from highs, unprofitable, and 24% short interest means nearly a quarter of tradeable shares are betting against it, making any recovery extremely difficult.
Sell BMNR — down 54% from its high with three consecutive earnings misses, negative momentum across every metric, and negative fundamentals confirm the thesis is broken.

Sell IONQ — the company is losing money, you're down 37% on your position, and despite quantum computing hype the 12% short interest and 55% drawdown say the market doesn't believe in the near-term story.

Trim MSTR to reduce risk — it's essentially a leveraged Bitcoin bet that's down 47% from highs, and in a rising-rate environment with sticky inflation, speculative crypto proxies carry outsized downside risk.

Add to ADBE on this pullback — a PE of 8.7 with double-digit revenue and free cash flow growth is genuinely cheap for a dominant software company, though size the position modestly given the elevated VIX environment.

Add to CNC — a PE of 12.6 with nearly 20% revenue growth and strong free cash flow in a defensive healthcare name is exactly the kind of holding that should perform well if macro conditions get rougher.
